_comment: TECH v0.7.1 QA-ONLY extended equipment ($13D-$13F). Never production content (production IDs $100-$126 are reserved for the 39 locked concepts; $127-$13C reserve). Each item clones a vanilla ItemProp record ('base') and overrides fields by name; offsets are the Rev 1 30-byte ItemProp layout (see ITEM_CONSUMER_AUDIT_v0.7.1.md). Low bytes $3D/$3E/$3F alias the vanilla Chocobo/DaVinci/Magical brushes, so any truncation would be immediately visible in QA.

items.name: QA Blade13D
items._equip_chars_note: 17FF = every character except Gau ($0800) and Umaro ($2000), who cannot hold a weapon in vanilla (their battle code rewrites the hand slots)
